metadata.title: Private Day Trips from Prague — Car & Chauffeur for the Day
metadata.description: Private day trips from Prague in a Mercedes with your own chauffeur: castles, spa towns, old towns and national parks. Hotel pickup, the driver waits, one price per car.
metadata.ogTitle: Private Day Trips from Prague with Your Own Chauffeur

hero.label: Private Day Trips · Prague
hero.headlineItalic: Your own car, your own clock.
hero.intro: Private day trips from Prague in a Mercedes with a chauffeur: collected at your hotel, driven to a castle, a spa town or a national park, and brought back the same day while the car waits for you.
hero.imageAlt: Mercedes on a motorway leaving Prague for a day trip

items.label: Where
items.value: Castles, spa towns, old towns and national parks, each on its own page below

items.label: Price
items.value: Per car, not per person — shown in full before you pay

items.label: Vehicles
items.value: Mercedes E-Class, S-Class and V-Class for up to six

items.label: Included
items.value: Hotel pickup, the drive both ways, fuel, motorway tolls and time at the destination

paragraphs: A private day trip is simple: one car and one chauffeur for your party only. You are collected at your Prague address, driven to the place you chose, left to explore on your own schedule, and driven back to the same door.

It is not a group tour. There is no coach, no fixed time in town and no waiting for other people. It is also not a guided tour: your chauffeur drives and waits, and you see the place on your own or with a local guide you book yourself.
The price is for the car, so it is the same for one passenger or for six in a V-Class.

items.title: One price for the car
items.body: Each trip has one price for the whole car, shown on its page and in full before you pay. It covers the drive there and back, fuel and motorway tolls.

items.title: Time at the destination is included
items.body: Every trip includes time at the destination, shown on its page. If you want more, add extra hours when you book.

items.title: Pickup and return at your Prague address
items.body: Your chauffeur collects you at your hotel or apartment and brings you back to the same door.

items.title: Pick the kind of day you like
items.body: Castles, spa towns, old towns, cities across the border or walking in a national park: each trip page tells you what the day looks like.

items.title: The chauffeur waits
items.body: While you visit, the car stays near the centre for the time you booked. When you are ready, call or message the chauffeur and you are collected where you were dropped.

items.title: Child seats at no charge
items.body: Infant, toddler and booster seats are free. Tell us the children’s ages when you book and the right seats are fitted before pickup.

steps.label: How it works
steps.heading: Booking a day trip in four steps.

items.title: Choose a trip
items.body: Open the trip you like, pick the date, the start time and the number of passengers. You see the cars that fit your group.

items.title: Choose the car
items.body: E-Class for up to three, V-Class for up to six with room to spare, S-Class for an executive day. You see the full price for the car before you pay.

items.title: Meet your chauffeur
items.body: You receive the chauffeur’s name and phone number in advance. They collect you at your hotel or apartment door at the agreed time.

items.title: Take your time
items.body: The chauffeur waits near the centre for the time you booked. If you would like to stay longer on the day, tell the chauffeur: extra time is charged only after a person at Prestigo agrees to it.

editorial.label: Choosing
paragraphs: Choose by the kind of day you want. For a short trip that fits a spare morning or afternoon, look for the places closest to Prague. For one unforgettable town, pick a castle town and leave early. For a slower day of walking, coffee and spa water, choose a spa town. For museums, architecture or a Christmas market, choose a city across the border. For fresh air, choose a national park and bring walking shoes.
The trips run all year. Some castle interiors close in the winter months and many museums close on Mondays, so check the date before you book.

Your chauffeur is a professional driver, not a tour guide: they know the road, where to drop you and where to wait, but they do not lead tours. Entrance tickets, meals and guided tours are not part of the price.

faqs.q: How much does a private day trip from Prague cost?
faqs.a: Every trip has one price for the whole car, set for each car class and shown on the trip page. It covers the drive there and back, fuel, motorway tolls and the time at the destination included in your booking. You can add extra hours when you book, and you see the exact total before you pay.

faqs.q: Is the price per person or per car?
faqs.a: Per car. One passenger or three in an E-Class pay the same, and so do one or six in a V-Class.

faqs.q: Does the chauffeur wait and drive us back the same day?
faqs.a: Yes. The same car and chauffeur take you there, wait near the centre for the time you booked and drive you back to your Prague address. If you decide to stay longer on the day, tell the chauffeur: extra time is charged only after a person at Prestigo agrees to it.

No. The price covers the car and the chauffeur, and the chauffeur does not act as a guide. Tickets and guided tours are booked separately; we are glad to help you time the day around a guide or a ticket slot you have booked.

faqs.q: Which is the best day trip from Prague?
faqs.a: That depends on what you like. Castle towns suit history and photography, spa towns suit a relaxed day, cities across the border suit museums and a second country, and national parks suit walking. Each trip page lists what the day includes.

faqs.q: Can we go somewhere that is not on this page?
faqs.a: Yes. Tell us the place and the date and we send you the price. For a day with several stops, a pickup outside Prague, or a trip of two days or more, send a custom tour request and we plan it with you.
